metadata.training: 24 independent stationary-A trials of length 30; Beta(1,1)
metadata.rng: SHA256 domain-separated independent training/test streams; common random numbers across scenarios
metadata.sham_scope: Only four scalar state-vector fields; target transition estimates/history/memory retained
metadata.sham_causality: Donor full-engine state at t-1 copied before any stream is updated at t
metadata.sham_limitation: Independent observation streams share regime timing; not an unconditional independence null
metadata.ci: Normal approximation mean +/- 1.96*s/sqrt(N); seeds are the units, not transitions or streams
metadata.paired_sign: full engine loss minus comparator loss; negative favors full engine
metadata.holdout: Disjoint fixed seeds; no hyperparameter search. Exploratory robustness, not independent preregistration.
metadata.interpretation: Functional prediction/state adaptation only; no phenomenological or MQGT-SCF validation
